Yeh ek soora hai jise hum ne naazil kiya hai aur farz kiya hai, aur is mein khuli hui nishaaniyaan naazil ki hain ke shaayad tum log naseehat haasil kar sako

Zinaakaar aurat aur zinaakaar mard dono ko sau sau kode lagaao, aur khabardaar deen-e-Khuda ke mu'aamle mein kisi murawwat ka shikaar na ho jaana agar tumhaara imaan Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat par hai, aur is saza ke waqt momineen ki ek jamaa'at ko haazir rehna chaahiye
Zaani mard zaaniya ya mushrika aurat hi se nikaah karega, aur zaaniya aurat zaani mard ya mushrik mard hi se nikaah karegi, ke yeh saahibaan-e-imaan par haraam hain

Aur jo log paak-daaman auraton par zina ki tohmat lagaate hain aur chaar gawaah faraaham nahin karte hain unhein assi kode lagaao, aur phir kabhi un ki gawaahi qubool na karna ke yeh log saraasar faasiq hain
Ilaawa un afraad ke jo is ke baad tauba kar lein aur apne nafs ki islaah kar lein, ke Allah bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Aur jo log apni biwiyon par tohmat lagaate hain aur un ke paas apne ilaawa koi gawaah nahin hota hai to un ki apni gawaahi chaar gawaahiyon ke baraabar hogi, agar woh chaar martaba qasam kha kar kahein ke woh sachche hain
Aur paanchwein martaba yeh kahein ke agar woh jhoote hain to un par Khuda ki la'nat hai
Phir aurat se bhi hadd bar-taraf ho sakti hai agar woh chaar martaba qasam kha kar yeh kahe ke yeh mard jhooton mein se hai
Aur paanchwein martaba yeh kahe ke agar woh saadiqeen mein se hai to mujh par Khuda ka ghazab hai
Aur agar tum par Khuda ka fazl aur us ki rehmat na hoti aur woh tauba qubool karne waala saahib-e-hikmat na hota (to is tohmat ka anjaam bahut bura hota)

Beshak jin logon ne zina ki tohmat lagaayi woh tum hi mein se ek giroh tha. Tum use apne haq mein shar na samjho, yeh tumhaare haq mein khair hai, aur har shakhs ke liye utna hi gunaah hai jo us ne khud kamaaya hai, aur un mein se jis ne bada hissa liya hai us ke liye bada azaab hai
Aakhir aisa kyon na hua ke jab tum logon ne is tohmat ko suna tha to momineen o mominaat apne baare mein khair ka gumaan karte aur kehte ke yeh to khula hua bohtaan hai
Phir aisa kyon na hua ke yeh chaar gawaah bhi le aate? Aur jab gawaah nahin le aaye to yeh Allah ke nazdeek bilkul jhoote hain
Aur agar Khuda ka fazl duniya o aakhirat mein aur us ki rehmat na hoti to jo charcha tum ne kiya tha us mein tumhein bahut bada azaab giraft mein le leta

Jab tum apni zabaan se charcha kar rahe the aur apne munh se woh baat nikaal rahe the jis ka tumhein ilm bhi nahin tha, aur tum use bahut ma'mooli baat samajh rahe the, haalaanke Allah ke nazdeek woh bahut badi baat thi
Aur kyon na aisa hua ke jab tum logon ne is baat ko suna tha to kehte ke humein aisi baat kehne ka koi haq nahin hai, Khudaaya! Tu paak o be-niyaaz hai, aur yeh bahut bada bohtaan hai
Allah tum ko naseehat karta hai ke agar tum saahib-e-imaan ho to ab aisi harkat dobaara hargiz na karna
Aur Allah tumhaare liye apni nishaaniyon ko waazeh kar ke bayaan karta hai, aur woh saahib-e-ilm bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Jo log yeh chaahte hain ke saahibaan-e-imaan mein badkaari ka charcha phail jaaye un ke liye bada dardnaak azaab hai, duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi, aur Allah sab kuch jaanta hai, sirf tum nahin jaante ho
Aur agar Allah ka fazl aur us ki rehmat tumhaare shaamil-e-haal na hoti aur woh shafeeq aur meharbaan na hota (to tum par azaab aa jaata)

Imaan waalo! Shaitaan ke naqsh-e-qadam par na chalna, ke jo Shaitaan ke qadam ba qadam chalega use Shaitaan har tarah ki buraai ka hukm dega. Aur agar tum par Allah ka fazl aur us ki rehmat na hoti to tum mein koi bhi paakbaaz na hota, lekin Allah jise chaahta hai paak o paakeeza bana deta hai, aur woh har ek ki sunne waala aur har ek ke haal-e-dil ka jaanne waala hai

Aur khabardaar tum mein se koi shakhs bhi jise Khuda ne fazl aur wus'at ata ki hai yeh qasam na kha le ke qaraabat-daaron aur miskeenon aur raah-e-Khuda mein hijrat karne waalon ke saath koi sulook na karega. Har ek ko maaf karna chaahiye aur darguzar karna chaahiye. Kya tum yeh nahin chaahte ho ke Khuda tumhaare gunaahon ko bakhsh de? Aur Allah beshak bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Yaqeenan jo log paakbaaz aur be-khabar momin auraton par tohmat lagaate hain un par duniya aur aakhirat dono jagah la'nat ki gayi hai, aur un ke liye azaab-e-azeem hai
Qiyaamat ke din un ke khilaaf un ki zabaanein aur un ke haath paaon sab gawaahi denge ke yeh kya kar rahe the
Us din Khuda sab ko poora poora badla dega, aur logon ko maaloom ho jaaega ke Khuda yaqeenan barhaq aur haq ka zaahir karne waala hai

Khabees cheezein khabees logon ke liye hain aur khabees afraad khabees baaton ke liye hain, aur paakeeza baatein paakeeza logon ke liye hain aur paakeeza afraad paakeeza baaton ke liye hain. Yeh paakeeza log khabees logon ke ittihaamaat se paak o paakeeza hain, aur un ke liye maghfirat aur ba-izzat rizq hai

Imaan waalo! Khabardaar apne gharon ke ilaawa kisi ke ghar mein daakhil na hona jab tak ke saahib-e-khaana se ijaazat na le lo aur unhein salaam na kar lo. Yahi tumhaare haq mein behtar hai ke shaayad tum is se naseehat haasil kar sako

Phir agar ghar mein koi na mile to us waqt tak daakhil na hona jab tak ijaazat na mil jaaye, aur agar tum se kaha jaaye ke waapas chale jaao to waapas chale jaana, ke yahi tumhaare liye zyaada paakeeza amr hai, aur Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Tumhaare liye koi harj nahin hai ke tum aise makaanaat mein jo ghair-aabaad hain aur jin mein tumhaara koi saamaan hai daakhil ho jaao, aur Allah us ko bhi jaanta hai jis ka tum izhaar karte ho aur us ko bhi jaanta hai jis ki tum parda-poshi karte ho

Aur Paighambar! Aap momineen se keh dijiye ke apni nigaahon ko neechi rakhein aur apni sharmgaahon ki hifaazat karein, ke yahi zyaada paakeeza baat hai, aur beshak Allah un ke kaarobaar se khoob baakhabar hai

Aur mominaat se keh dijiye ke woh bhi apni nigaahon ko neecha rakhein aur apni iffat ki hifaazat karein, aur apni zeenat ka izhaar na karein ilaawa us ke jo az-khud zaahir hai, aur apne dupatte ko apne girebaan par rakhein, aur apni zeenat ko apne baap daada, shohar, shohar ke baap daada, apni aulaad aur apne shohar ki aulaad, apne bhai aur bhaiyon ki aulaad aur behnon ki aulaad, aur apni auraton aur apne ghulaam aur kaneezon, aur aise taabe' afraad jin mein aurat ki taraf se koi khwaahish nahin reh gayi hai, aur woh bachche jo auraton ke parde ki baat se koi sarokaar nahin rakhte hain, in sab ke ilaawa kisi par zaahir na karein. Aur khabardaar apne paaon patak kar na chalein ke jis zeenat ko chhupaaye hue hain us ka izhaar ho jaaye. Aur saahibaan-e-imaan! Tum sab Allah ki baargaah mein tauba karte raho ke shaayad isi tarah tumhein falaah aur najaat haasil ho jaaye

Aur apne ghair-shaadi-shuda aazaad afraad aur apne ghulaamon aur kaneezon mein se ba-salaahiyat afraad ke nikaah ka ehtemaam karo, ke agar woh faqeer bhi honge to Khuda apne fazl o karam se inhein maaldaar bana dega, ke Khuda badi wus'at waala aur saahib-e-ilm hai

Aur jo log nikaah ki wus'at nahin rakhte hain woh bhi apni iffat ka tahaffuz karein yahaan tak ke Khuda apne fazl se inhein ghani bana de. Aur jo ghulaam o kaneez mukaatabat ke talabgaar hain un mein khair dekho to un se mukaatabat kar lo, balke jo maal Khuda ne tumhein de rakha hai us mein se kuch inhein bhi de do. Aur khabardaar apni kaneezon ko agar woh paakdaamani ki khwaahishmand hain to zina par majboor na karna ke un se zindagaani-e-duniya ka faaida haasil karna chaaho, ke jo bhi inhein majboor karega Khuda majboori ke baad un auraton ke haq mein bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Aur hum ne tumhaari taraf apni khuli hui nishaaniyaan, aur tum se pehle guzar jaane waalon ki misaal, aur saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye naseehat ka saamaan naazil kiya hai

Allah aasmaanon aur zameen ka noor hai. Us ke noor ki misaal us taaq ki hai jis mein chiraagh ho, aur chiraagh sheeshe ki qandeel mein ho, aur qandeel ek jagmagaate sitaare ke maanind ho jo zaitoon ke ba-barakat darakht se raushan kiya jaaye, jo na mashriq waala ho na maghrib waala, aur qareeb hai ke us ka roghan bhadak uthe chaahe use aag mas bhi na kare. Yeh noor baala-e-noor hai, aur Allah apne noor ke liye jise chaahta hai hidaayat de deta hai, aur isi tarah misaalein bayaan karta hai, aur woh har shai ka jaanne waala hai

Yeh chiraagh un gharon mein hai jin ke baare mein Khuda ka hukm hai ke un ki bulandi ka e'teraaf kiya jaaye aur un mein us ke naam ka zikr kiya jaaye, ke un gharon mein subah o shaam us ki tasbeeh karne waale hain

Woh mard jinhein kaarobaar ya deegar khareed o farokht zikr-e-Khuda, qiyaam-e-namaaz aur adaa-e-zakaat se ghaafil nahin kar sakti. Yeh us din se darte hain jis din ke haul se dil aur nigaahein sab ulat jaayengi
Taake Khuda inhein un ke behtareen aamaal ki jaza de sake aur apne fazl se mazeed izaafa kar sake, aur Khuda jise chaahta hai rizq be-hisaab ata karta hai

Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya un ke aamaal us ret ke maanind hain jo chateel maidaan mein ho aur pyaasa use dekh kar paani tasawwur kare, aur jab us ke qareeb pahunche to kuch na paaye, balke us Khuda ko paaye jo us ka poora poora hisaab kar de, ke Allah bahut jald hisaab karne waala hai

Ya un aamaal ki misaal us gehre darya ki taareekiyon ki hai jise ek ke oopar ek lehar dhaank le, aur us ke oopar teh-ba-teh baadal bhi hon, ke jab woh apne haath ko nikaale to taareeki ki bina par kuch nazar na aaye, aur jis ke liye Khuda noor na qaraar de us ke liye koi noor nahin hai

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki tamaam makhlooqaat aur fiza ke saf-basta taa'ir sab tasbeeh kar rahe hain, aur sab apni apni namaaz aur tasbeeh se baakhabar hain, aur Allah bhi un ke aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
Aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki milkiyat hai aur usi ki taraf sab ki baazgasht hai

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Khuda hi abr ko chalaata hai aur phir unhein aapas mein jod kar teh-ba-teh bana deta hai, phir tum dekhoge ke us ke darmiyaan se baarish nikal rahi hai, aur woh use aasmaan se barf ke pahaadon ke darmiyaan se barsaata hai, phir jis tak chaahta hai pahuncha deta hai aur jis ki taraf se chaahta hai mod deta hai. Us ki bijli ki chamak itni tez hai ke qareeb hai ke aankhon ki beenaai khatm kar de
Allah hi raat aur din ko ulat palat karta rehta hai, aur yaqeenan is mein saahibaan-e-basaarat ke liye saamaan-e-ibrat hai

Aur Allah hi ne har zameen par chalne waale ko paani se paida kiya hai, phir un mein se ba'z pet ke bal chalte hain aur ba'z do pairon se chalte hain aur ba'z chaaron haath pair se chalte hain, aur Allah jo chaahta hai paida karta hai, ke woh har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Yaqeenan hum ne waazeh karne waali aayatein naazil ki hain, aur Allah jise chaahta hai Siraat-e-Mustaqeem ki hidaayat de deta hai
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke hum Allah aur Rasool par imaan le aaye hain aur un ki itaa'at ki hai, aur us ke baad un mein se ek fareeq munh pher leta hai, aur yeh waaqai saahibaan-e-imaan nahin hain
Aur jab inhein Khuda o Rasool ki taraf bulaaya jaata hai ke woh un ke darmiyaan faisla kar dein to un mein se ek fareeq kinaara-kash ho jaata hai
Haalaanke agar haq un ke saath hota to yeh sar jhukaaye hue chale aate

To kya un ke dilon mein kufr ki beemaari hai, ya yeh shak mein mubtala ho gaye hain, ya inhein yeh khauf hai ke Khuda aur Rasool un par zulm karenge? Haalaanke haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh log khud hi zaalimeen hain
Momineen ko to jab Khuda aur Rasool ki taraf bulaaya jaata hai ke woh faisla karenge to un ka qaul sirf yeh hota hai ke hum ne suna aur itaa'at ki, aur yahi log dar-haqeeqat falaah paane waale hain
Aur jo bhi Allah aur Rasool ki itaa'at karega aur us ke dil mein khauf-e-Khuda hoga aur woh parhezgaari ikhtiyaar karega to wahi kaamyaab kaha jaaega

Aur un logon ne baa-qaa'ida qasam khaayi hai ke aap hukm de denge to yeh ghar se baahar nikal jaayenge. To aap keh dijiye ke qasam ki zaroorat nahin hai, umoomi qaanoon ke mutaabiq itaa'at kaafi hai, ke yaqeenan Allah un aamaal se baakhabar hai jo tum log anjaam de rahe ho

Aap keh dijiye ke Allah aur us ke Rasool ki itaa'at karo. Phir agar inhiraaf karoge to Rasool par woh zimmedaari hai jo us ke zimme rakhi gayi hai aur tum par woh mas'ooliyat hai jo tumhaare zimme rakhi gayi hai, aur agar tum itaa'at karoge to hidaayat pa jaaoge, aur Rasool ke zimme waazeh tableegh ke siwa aur kuch nahin hai

Allah ne tum mein se saahibaan-e-imaan o amal-e-saaleh se waada kiya hai ke unhein roo-e-zameen mein isi tarah apna khaleefa banaaega jis tarah pehle waalon ko banaaya hai, aur un ke liye us deen ko ghaalib banaaega jise un ke liye pasandeeda qaraar diya hai, aur un ke khauf ko amn se tabdeel kar dega, ke woh sab sirf meri ibaadat karenge aur kisi tarah ka shirk na karenge. Aur us ke baad bhi koi kaafir ho jaaye to dar-haqeeqat wahi log faasiq aur badkirdaar hain
Aur namaaz qaaim karo, zakaat ada karo aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo ke shaayad isi tarah tumhaare haal par rahm kiya jaaye
Khabardaar yeh khayaal na karna ke kufr ikhtiyaar karne waale zameen mein hum ko aajiz kar dene waale hain. Un ka thikaana Jahannam hai aur woh badtareen anjaam hai

Imaan waalo! Tumhaare ghulaam o kaneez aur woh bachche jo abhi sinn-e-buloogh ko nahin pahunche hain un sab ko chaahiye ke tumhaare paas daakhil hone ke liye teen auqaat mein ijaazat lein: namaaz-e-subah se pehle, aur dopahar ke waqt jab tum kapde utaar kar aaraam karte ho, aur namaaz-e-ishaa ke baad. Yeh teen auqaat parde ke hain. Us ke baad tumhaare liye ya un ke liye koi harj nahin hai ke ek doosre ke paas chakkar lagaate rahein. Ke Allah isi tarah apni aayaton ko waazeh kar ke bayaan karta hai, aur beshak Allah har shai ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Aur jab tumhaare bachche hadd-e-buloogh ko pahunch jaayein to woh bhi isi tarah ijaazat lein jis tarah pehle waale ijaazat liya karte the. Parwardigar isi tarah tumhaare liye apni aayaton ko waazeh kar ke bayaan karta hai, ke woh saahib-e-ilm bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Aur za'eefi se baith rehne waali auratein jinhein nikaah se koi dilchaspi nahin hai un ke liye koi harj nahin hai ke woh apne zaahiri kapdon ko alag kar dein, ba-shart-e-ke zeenat ki numaaish na karein, aur woh bhi iffat ka tahaffuz karti rahein ke yahi un ke haq mein bhi behtar hai, aur Allah sab ki sunne waala aur sab ka haal jaanne waala hai

Naabeena ke liye koi harj nahin hai aur langde aadmi ke liye bhi koi harj nahin hai aur mareez ke liye bhi koi aib nahin hai, aur khud tumhaare liye bhi koi gunaah nahin hai ke apne gharon se, ya apne baap daada ke gharon se, ya apni maa aur naani daadi ke gharon se, ya apne bhaiyon ke gharon se, ya apni behnon ke gharon se, ya apne chachaaon ke gharon se, ya apni phuphiyon ke gharon se, ya apne maamuon ke gharon se, ya apni khaalaaon ke gharon se, ya jin gharon ki kunjiyaan tumhaare ikhtiyaar mein hain, ya apne doston ke gharon se khaana kha lo. Aur tumhaare liye is mein bhi koi harj nahin hai ke sab mil kar khaao ya mutafarriq tareeqe se khaao. Bas jab gharon mein daakhil ho to kam az kam apne hi oopar salaam kar lo, ke yeh Parwardigar ki taraf se nihaayat hi mubaarak aur paakeeza tohfa hai, aur Parwardigar isi tarah apni aayaton ko waazeh tareeqe se bayaan karta hai ke shaayad tum aql se kaam le sako

Momineen sirf woh afraad hain jo Khuda aur Rasool par imaan rakhte hon, aur jab kisi ijtimaai kaam mein masroof hon to us waqt tak kahin na jaayein jab tak ijaazat haasil na ho jaaye. Beshak jo log aap se ijaazat haasil karte hain wahi Allah aur Rasool par imaan rakhte hain. Lihaaza jab aap se kisi khaas haalat ke liye ijaazat talab karein to aap jis ko chaahein ijaazat de dein, aur un ke haq mein Allah se istighfaar bhi karein ke Allah bada Ghafoor aur Raheem hai

Musalmaano! Khabardaar Rasool ko is tarah na pukaara karo jis tarah aapas mein ek doosre ko pukaarte ho. Allah un logon ko khoob jaanta hai jo tum mein se khaamoshi se khisak jaate hain. Lihaaza jo log hukm-e-Khuda ki mukhaalifat karte hain woh is amr se darein ke un tak koi fitna pahunch jaaye ya koi dardnaak azaab naazil ho jaaye

Aur yaad rakho ke Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki kul kaainaat hai, aur woh tumhaare haalaat ko khoob jaanta hai, aur jis din sab us ki baargaah mein palta kar laaye jaayenge woh sab ko un ke aamaal ke baare mein bata dega, ke woh har shai ka jaanne waala hai
